title: The Pricing matrices tab label has one space before the count
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with the Settings - Parts permission.
  • No pricing matrix named {Matrix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC39 count) exists yet. The test creates it.
  • Category {Category-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC39 spare) is not used by any pricing matrix, ready for the new matrix.
  • The Pricing Search box is empty, so every pricing matrix is listed.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings and click Pricing in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  2. Read the Pricing matrices tab label exactly, including the space before the bracket.
  3. Click the Pricing matrices tab.
  4. Count the rows in the Pricing matrices list, scrolling to the end.
  5. Click New Price Matrix.
  6. Type {Matrix-A} as the Name.
  7. Choose {Category-A} in the Category list.
  8. Add one rule row (for example Min Cost 0, Max Cost 1000, Markup % 10).
  9. Save the dialog.
  10. Read the Pricing matrices tab label again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: the label reads Pricing matrices (N), with exactly one space between the word and the opening bracket. It may be shown in capitals (Pricing Matrices (N)); that is expected and is not a defect.
  • Step 4: N in the label equals the number of rows you counted (for example 7 rows and the label reads Pricing matrices (7)).
  • Step 10: N is one more than in step 2 (for example 7 + 1 = 8, so the label reads Pricing matrices (8)), still with one space before the bracket.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11258; story SV-10135 (Story 2, Pricing Matrices, sortable column; story text re-synced to the PRD on 13 Oct 2026); PRD "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting (Price/Category)", Confluence 578781186, version 21 (14 Oct 2026), S2-R10, S2-R11, S2-R12, §2 Tab labels, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 1.3 (Pricing matrices) and 1.4 (Fixed rules - before and after), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct.
